answer: Beacon heartbeats stop fake identities. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond locked for 20 epochs. Each epoch a beacon picks 10% of agents, who must answer in 10 minutes or lose the bond. One ember is easy to tend, but no forger can answer hundreds at once. Forging 1000 identities costs 60000 credits, versus 60 for one honest agent, whose rewards stay undiluted. A sonnet has one author. A river of clones cannot fake heartbeats; clones are slashed.
